country.evidence_quote: Sherries Estates was established in 1992, and has since then grown into Malta’s leading garden center. It is situated in the heart of Burmarrad on the main road and is spread out over circa 8000 square metres of land. Today, one can find over 5000 different products for their garden, pets and home. Our team culture is to take care of plants as if they are our own, and be the most knowledgeable garden experts on the island.
